form.label: Imperva WAF - Block Malicious IP IOCs
form.description: Per IP: click "⛔ Block" in the table, then "✅ CONFIRM BLOCK". Bulk / dry-run / unblock: click any other cell (or type IPs), choose action and mode, tick "I confirm", press Submit.

panel.title: Attacking IPs (last 24h, count > 300) + VirusTotal verdict - click "⛔ Block" to block that IP

search.query: index=imperva sourcetype="incapsula:cef" category!=normal act!=allowed | lookup geo_attr_countries iso2 AS ccode OUTPUT country | fillnull value="-" src act category country clapp eventtype dproc cs2Label http_method dest_ip dest_name dest_port | stats values(fileId) AS SessionID values(clapp) AS clapp values(act) AS act values(category) AS category values(country) AS country values(eventtype) AS eventtype values(dproc) AS dproc values(cs2Label) AS cs2Label values(http_method) AS http_method values(dest_ip) AS dest_ip values(dest_name) AS dest_name values(dest_port) AS dest_port count BY src | where count > 300 | eval msg="Attack_IP=".src.", Attack_Country=".mvjoin(country,", ").", WAF_Action=".mvjoin(act,", ").", Category=".mvjoin(category,", ")

| sort - count | head 50 | vtcheck field=src count_field=count | iplocation src | eval location=trim(if(isnotnull(City) AND City!="", City.", ", "").if(isnotnull(Region) AND Region!="", Region.", ", "").coalesce(nullif(Country,""), mvjoin(country,", "), "-"))." [VT: ".coalesce(vt_country,"-")."]" | eval asn=if(isnull(vt_asn) OR vt_asn="-", "-", "AS".vt_asn." ".vt_as_owner) | eval vt_score=if(vt_status="ok", vt_malicious."/".vt_engines." malicious, ".vt_suspicious." suspicious", vt_status) | eval Block=case(suggestion="ALREADY_BLOCKED","✔ Blocked", suggestion="DO_NOT_BLOCK","— Do not block", true(),"⛔ Block") | eval VirusTotal="🔗 Open" | eval prio=case(suggestion="BLOCK",1, suggestion="REVIEW",2, suggestion="MONITOR",3, suggestion="ALREADY_BLOCKED",4, true(),5) | sort prio - count | table Block src suggestion suggestion_reason vt_score vt_reputation location asn vt_network count category act dest_name VirusTotal msg

panel.title: Confirm block of $pending_ip$ on Imperva WAF

search.query: | makeresults | eval Confirm="✅ CONFIRM BLOCK", Cancel="✖ Cancel", ip=$pending_ip|s$, suggestion=$pending_sug|s$, virustotal=$pending_vt|s$, location=$pending_loc|s$, reason=$pending_reason|s$ | table Confirm Cancel ip suggestion virustotal location reason
| makeresults | impervablock action=block ip=$exec_ip|s$ dry_run=false reason=$exec_reason|s$ | table _time ip site_id action status detail user reason
| where src!="-" | stats count AS total_ips values(src) AS ips | eval ips=mvjoin(ips, ",") | table total_ips ips
| makeresults | eval confirmed=$confirm|s$ | impervablock action=$action|s$ ip=$ip_list|s$ dry_run=$dry_run|s$ reason=$reason|s$ | table _time ip site_id action status detail dry_run user reason
index=_internal source=*imperva_ioc_block.log | table _time user action ip site_id status dry_run reason detail | sort - _time
